{{Quote|We're doomed!|Droid response to seeing an ionization blaster|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Jawa ionization blasters''', also known as '''Jawa ion rifle''', were built by the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to capture [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The guns themselves were cobbled together from whatever scrap the Jawas could scavenge. The gun was made of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] stripped down to its [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]], and then had its components replaced with an [[Ion accelerator/Legends|ion accelerator]] which was created using a droid [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] and an [[Accu-accelerator/Legends|accu-accelerator]] from a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] ignition system.

When fired, the blaster attached the restraining bolt to the droid and then ordered a stop command which made the droid halt. Normally the bolt just told a droid to halt, but the addition of the accu-accelerator caused a large ion burst to completely disable the droid for a short while. Its maximum range was about 12 meters while its optimum range was about 8 meters. The blaster would cause no damage against organic creatures but would give them a nasty sting.

A Jawa ionization blaster was used to capture [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] when they were stranded on Tatooine.
